title: Multi-Target Tracking of Cooperating Swarms by an Ensemble Gaussian Mixture Filter
summary: Per-target labeled random-finite-set filters, such as the state of the art $δ$-generalized labeled multi-Bernoulli filter, cannot represent cooperating, swarm-like, motion between targets. In this work, we present a new filter that can. The new particle filter couples the joint particle filter with ensemble Gaussian mixture filter such that a measurement updates the density at every particle instead of merely reweighting.
